title:
Listens to 'STEP_INDEX_UPDATE' and 'FORM_SUBMIT' on 'Reliability.CreateCaseMultiStepForm'.
When we create a new case in All Cases component, this epic
validates to ensure all the required fields in all the nested forms are filled.
If it's not valid, opens 'Reliability.ModalBanner', informing user to fill all the required fields.
If it's valid, it triggers {@link UiSdlEpicAddToCase}.
name: ValidateCreateCaseFormFieldsEpic
